newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Britain's Hanley to visit Hong Kong, New Zealand.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Hanley to visit Hong Kong, New Zealand.

text.p: Britain's minister of state at the Foreign and Commonwealth Office, Jeremy Hanley, will visit Hong Kong and New Zealand from January 29 to February 3, the British Trade Commission in Hong Kong said on Monday.
During Hanley's stay in the territory from January 29 to 31, he will hold talks with Hong Kong Governor Chris Patten and meet his cabinet, the Executive Council.
Hanley will also attend the opening of the new British Consulate building.
In New Zealand, Hanley will attend the launch of a programme of events aimed at promoting the country's ties with Britain.
